```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

generate_secreted_protein_circular_plot <- function(
    secprotcell_path,
    repo_local_dir,
    pdf_output_path,
    gsutil_cmd = "gsutil"
) {
  # --- Load Required Libraries ---
  required_libs <- c(
    "dplyr", "tidyr", "ComplexHeatmap", "circlize", "RColorBrewer", "grid",
    "openxlsx", "stringr", "purrr", "MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData",
    "MotrpacHumanPreSuspension",
    "ggplot2", "ggnewscale", "geomtextpath", "scales"
  )
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(lapply(required_libs, library, character.only = TRUE))
  
  plot_dir  <- dirname(pdf_output_path)
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  # --- Load Input Data ---
  secprotcell <- read.csv(secprotcell_path, check.names = FALSE)
  
  da_blood_prot_fil_data <- load_differential_analysis(
    repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
    selected_omes = "prot-ol",
    selected_tissues = "blood",
    single_matrix = TRUE,
    combine_with_featgene = TRUE,
    epigen = FALSE,
    gsutil = gsutil_cmd
  ) %>%
    filter(contrast_type == "exercise_with_controls")
  
  # --- Secreted protein filtering ---
  da_sec_prot <- secprotcell %>% dplyr::select(name, "tissue label", "uniprot")
  
  da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant <- da_blood_prot_fil_data %>%
    filter(adj_p_value < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(in_sec_prot = uniprot %in% da_sec_prot$uniprot)
  
  da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant_in_sec_prot <- da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant %>%
    filter(in_sec_prot) %>%
    left_join(da_sec_prot, by = "uniprot")
  
  da_sec_prot_sub_da <- secprotcell %>%
    filter(uniprot %in% da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant$uniprot)
  
  mapping <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::HUMAN_FEATURE_TO_GENE %>%
    filter(assay == "prot-ol") %>%
    dplyr::select(feature_id, uniprot, gene_symbol) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  da_sec_prot_sub_da <- merge(mapping, da_sec_prot_sub_da, by = "uniprot")
  
  # --- Data wrangling for plotting ---
  df_long <- da_sec_prot_sub_da %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol, `Global label`) %>%
    mutate(`Global label` = as.character(`Global label`)) %>%
    separate_rows(`Global label`, sep = "\\.") %>%
    mutate(`Global label` = str_trim(`Global label`)) %>%
    filter(`Global label` != "") %>%
    mutate(present = 1)
  
  df_wide <- df_long %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = gene_symbol,
      names_from = `Global label`,
      values_from = present,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  gls_data <- da_sec_prot_sub_da %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol, `Gobal label score (GLS)`) %>%
    distinct(gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  df_final <- left_join(df_wide, gls_data, by = "gene_symbol")
  
  df_long_plot <- df_final %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_symbol, `Gobal label score (GLS)`),
                 names_to = "Tissue", values_to = "Present") %>%
    filter(Present == 1) %>%
    mutate(GLS_group = paste0("GLS_", round(`Gobal label score (GLS)`))) %>%
    arrange(Tissue, desc(`Gobal label score (GLS)`)) %>%
    mutate(Gene_ID = row_number())
  
  # --- Helper: get_mode ---
  get_mode <- function(x) {
    ux <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
    if (length(ux) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    tab <- tabulate(match(x, ux))
    ux[which.max(tab)]
  }
  
  df_prep <- df_long_plot %>%
    dplyr::rename(gls_score = `Gobal label score (GLS)`,
           tissue = Tissue,
           gls_group = GLS_group) %>%
    mutate(
      tissue = factor(tissue),
      gls_group = factor(gls_group)
    ) %>%
    arrange(tissue, gls_score) %>%
    mutate(plot_id = row_number())
  
  df_prep <- df_prep %>%
    mutate(
      tissue = dplyr::recode(
        tissue,
        "adiposetissue" = "adipose tissue",
        "bonemarrow" = "bone marrow",
        "adrenalgland" = "adrenal gland",
        "bcell" = "b-cell",
        "tcellcd8" = "t-cell CD8+",
        "tcellcd4" = "t-cell CD4+"
      )
    )
  
  # --- Define Colors ---
  n_tissues <- nlevels(df_prep$tissue)
  tissue_palette <- scales::hue_pal()(n_tissues)
  tissue_colors <- setNames(tissue_palette, levels(df_prep$tissue))
  
  unique_gls_groups <- levels(df_prep$gls_group)
  group_numeric_values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("GLS_", "", unique_gls_groups)))
  ordered_gls_names <- unique_gls_groups[order(group_numeric_values)]
  n_groups <- length(ordered_gls_names)
  grey_palette <- gray(seq(0.85, 0.1, length.out = n_groups))
  gls_colors <- setNames(grey_palette, ordered_gls_names)
  
  # --- Prepare Annotation Data ---
  ring_data <- df_prep %>%
    group_by(tissue) %>%
    summarise(
      start_id = min(plot_id),
      end_id = max(plot_id),
      mid_id = mean(plot_id),
      gls_group_representative = get_mode(gls_group),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(tissue_color = tissue_colors[match(tissue, names(tissue_colors))])
  
  max_gls <- max(df_prep$gls_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  ring_width <- max_gls * 0.08
  outer_ring_ymax <- max_gls + 2.5 * ring_width
  outer_ring_ymin <- max_gls + 1.5 * ring_width
  inner_ring_ymax <- outer_ring_ymin
  inner_ring_ymin <- outer_ring_ymin - ring_width
  plot_ylim_outer <- outer_ring_ymax * 1.05
  radial_breaks <- scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)(c(0, max_gls))
  
  n_points <- 500
  radial_label_data <- lapply(radial_breaks, function(r) {
    data.frame(
      angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_points),
      x = seq(0, max(df_prep$plot_id), length.out = n_points),
      y = r,
      label = paste0(format(r, digits = 2))
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows(.id = "label_id")
  
  # --- Plot ---
  p_circular_legends <- ggplot(df_prep) +
    geom_bar(aes(x = plot_id, y = gls_score, fill = tissue),
             stat = "identity", width = 1, color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = tissue_colors, name = "Tissue", guide = "legend") +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_rect(data = ring_data,
              aes(xmin = start_id - 0.5, xmax = end_id + 0.5,
                  ymin = inner_ring_ymin, ymax = inner_ring_ymax,
                  fill = gls_group_representative),
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = gls_colors, name = "GLS Group", guide = "legend") +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_rect(data = ring_data,
              aes(xmin = start_id - 0.5, xmax = end_id + 0.5,
                  ymin = outer_ring_ymin, ymax = outer_ring_ymax),
              fill = ring_data$tissue_color, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, plot_ylim_outer),
                       breaks = radial_breaks,
                       labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_polar(start = 0, clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linetype = "dotted"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    ) +
    geom_textpath(
      data = radial_label_data,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, group = label_id),
      size = 3, text_only = TRUE, upright = TRUE,
      vjust = -0.5, linewidth = 0.25
    )
  
  # --- Save as PDF ---
  ggsave(pdf_output_path, plot = p_circular_legends, device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
  
  message("✅ PDF saved at: ", pdf_output_path)
  return(p_circular_legends)
}


```
